Lincoln Fletcher: Hey everyone — Lincoln here, starting today on Eng Platform (remote, ATL). Quick q's: who should I DM for VPN/SSH access and adding my public key? How do I request MDM enrollment / laptop setup? Also: sticker form? favorite lunch spots near SF office for when I'm in town? Thanks!

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Lincoln!! :tada: Buddy assigned: Sam W. Sam will ping you about onboarding sync. For swag/stickers fill the form here: https://redwood.company/swag-form. We track allergies — any dietary restrictions?

Sam Wells: Hey Lincoln — welcome! I'll DM you in a sec. For SSH/VPN: open a ticket at https://it.redwood/portal and tag eng-ops. In the ticket paste your public key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub). We'll also add you to the WireGuard group.

Jo Park: For the key, easiest is: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "lincoln@redwood.com"` then `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste into the portal. If you prefer, I can add it for you once you DM me the public key.

IT-Bot: New IT ticket created: #IT-7183 — "Onboard Lincoln: VPN, SSH, MDM" — assigned to eng-ops. ETA: 1 business day.

Asha (DevEx): Stickers + laptop decals: we usually ship a sticker pack in the welcome box. If you want extra designs, select on the swag form. Also we have Ramen Friday in SF office — join whenever you're around (12:30ish).

Max (Eng SRE): Quick note for mac users: after MDM you'll get the company profiles and a VPN config. If you're on macOS Sonoma, let us know — we've seen a WireGuard quirk and can provide a patched profile.

Lincoln Fletcher: Awesome, thanks all! I'll submit the portal ticket now and DM Sam. No allergies (allergic to shellfish, though). Looking forward to Ramen Friday if I'm in SF soon. Appreciate the fast responses :rocket:

Maya (People Ops): Noted re: shellfish, we'll mark your profile. Welcome again!
